scope: Daily CSI method adaptation, not the private 15-minute paper benchmark
features: Qlib Alpha158 on source price times cumulative adjustment factor, raw volume
label: adjusted_close[t+2]/adjusted_close[t+1]-1; one-session execution lag
split_purge: label exit must fall within train/validation; test has two-session completion tail
normalization: Training-only per-factor mean/std, clip [-5,5], preserve missingness
eligibility: Historical member at decision t; positive current close/volume/factor; all 16x158 observed features finite
optimizer: Adam, no optimizer weight decay; explicit paper L2 term
schedule: lr(epoch)=initial_lr/sqrt(epoch), a reconstruction choice based on Section 3.5
checkpoint: maximum mean validation cross-sectional Pearson IC
portfolio: top50 +0.5 NAV and bottom50 -0.5 NAV, gross exposure 1, rebalance daily
cost: 0.001 times liquidated long and short notional after price drift; no charge on new exposure; final liquidation included
inference: Whole cross section, never split arbitrary chunks for CSD
missing_selected_return: Raw missing labels excluded only from supervised loss and IC; execution uses last observed adjusted-close marks, blocks untradable names at t+1 and freezes untradable holdings
selection: Fixed settings and seeds; no choice based on held-out 2024 metrics
